# Check that commands in cmd are install to $BOLERO_ROOT/bin, not $BOLERO_BIN.
# Verifies golang.org/issue/32674.
env BOLERO_BIN=gobin
mkdir gobin
bolero list -f '{{.Target}}' cmd/go
stdout $BOLERO_ROOT${/}bin${/}bolero$GOEXE

# Check that tools are installed to $BOLERO_TOOLDIR, not $BOLERO_BIN.
bolero list -f '{{.Target}}' cmd/compile
stdout $BOLERO_ROOT${/}pkg${/}tool${/}${GOOS}_${GOARCH}${/}compile$GOEXE
